name: claude-launcher-mcp
description: MCP server that lets Claude Code create, build and install Minecraft mods through Claude Launcher

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/claude-launcher-mcp.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
